name: Inkarnate asset catalog backup to Google Drive
goal: Put a verified, zstd-compressed SQLite online-backup snapshot of the 3.65 GB inkarnate asset_catalog.db (plus SHA256SUMS) in Google Drive; verify by integrity_check, per-table row counts, scripted hash match, and cloud-side size/md5 via the Google Drive connector.

tasks.name: Snapshot, verify, compress, copy to Drive, verify cloud upload
tasks.description: No tests required: operational backup with built-in verification; no executable code. Exact commands: human plan Task 1 Steps 1-8. Source opened -readonly (sidecars never touched); --long=27 on every zstd step; quote the Drive path; Bash timeout 1800000 on long steps. Temp dir deleted ONLY after Step 7b confirms the upload in the cloud via the Google Drive connector (size match; md5 match if exposed); else stop and keep temp.

steps.description: df -h /System/Volumes/Data (>= ~10 GiB free); SQLite online backup opening source -readonly
Per-table row counts source vs snapshot per human plan Task 1 Step 3
Hash snapshot, zstd -19 -T0 --long=27, zstd -t, hash .zst, scripted decompressed-hash compare, record .zst md5 + byte size, per human plan Task 1 Step 4
steps.expected: DECOMPRESS MATCH (MISMATCH stops); md5 + size recorded.

steps.description: Append restore note to SHA256SUMS per human plan Task 1 Step 5
mkdir Drive folder; copy .zst + SHA256SUMS; ls per human plan Task 1 Step 6
steps.expected: Both files present in Drive folder.

steps.description: 7a: read back local Drive-cache .zst -> decompressed hash == snapshot hash
7b: Google Drive connector search_files title = 'asset_catalog-2026-10-11.db.zst' + get_file_metadata; recheck ~2 min up to 60 min
steps.expected: Cloud file exists; size == Step 4 size; md5 == Step 4 md5 if exposed. No size exposed or not confirmed in 60 min: stop, keep temp, report.

steps.description: Only after 7b: rm -r /private/tmp/inkarnate-catalog-backup; append 'Catalog backup' section to findings; stage
